endpoint.scope: explicit account/project/region/pool; Russian documented pool template only, exact override elsewhere

request.mapping: Explicit access_rule ref with exact caller share parent; path uses parent ID, body.deny_access.access_id uses rule ID. No discovery/name lookup/adoption/fallback.

response.mapping: Pinned controller bodyless202 acceptance only, no rule application/absence assertion. Receipt retains exact caller rule+parent, unknown never replays.

errors.mapping: Safe shared HTTP status taxonomy; documented 400/401/403/404 are Rejected. Unexpected server/transport outcome remains Unknown without replay. Local validation returns revision-bound NotSent0attempts. Accepted exact refs survive independent decode errors.

recovery.reason: No causal replay proof. Exact caller/accepted returned refs may be explicitly observed using available typed reads; no name lookup/adoption or automatic replay.

limitations: Modern2.73 wire counterpart pinned upstream; Selectel availability for this exact microversion/shape unconfirmed. Owned source reconciliation #70/#74/#76; not complete provider capability.
